# StudioVoxario

> Czech gaming community hub with forums, news, live streams, leaderboards, game servers and a Discord bot manager.

StudioVoxario is a modern, futuristic gaming community where players discover servers, follow live streams, discuss games in the forum, read news and manage their own Discord communities.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Live streams, featured servers, top players and latest news.
- [News](/novinky): Game release calendar and community news.
- [Forum](/forum): Community discussions across multiple categories.
- [Leaderboard](/leaderboard): Top contributors and most active members.
- [Servers](/servery): Browse and submit community game servers.

## Optional

- [Terms](/terms): Terms of service.
- [Privacy](/privacy): Privacy policy.
- [Sign in](/auth): Create an account or sign in.
